operator_directive: 2026-10-04: 3 hyper-fine-tuned micro-models per Project HENRI.pdf; no off-the-shelf backbones; clean minimal operational ML model; staged for benchmarking
gate_rule: Every gate names fail_if. A gate that cannot fail is a defect. Each mechanism carries a negative control that MUST fail when the mechanism is absent.

gates.name: ingress signal purity
gates.fail_if: any unused 4-slot subspace holds a non-zero sample (noise-fill defect)
gates.negative_control: fill unused slots with a phase vector -> noise_hash_rows MUST exceed 0

gates.name: gram crosstalk bound
gates.fail_if: max |off-diagonal| of the dual Gram matrix exceeds 0.12 after Stiefel retraction
gates.negative_control: skip retraction -> offdiag_max MUST stay above 0.12

gates.name: swarm lattice coverage
gates.source: doc p40 G-U3 (sub-50us on 5090; N/A on CPU)
gates.fail_if: workers share perturbation seeds (cross-talk leak, Gate S-1)
gates.negative_control: force a shared seed -> distinct_seeds MUST fall to 1
gates.cpu_note: latency bound T_step<=50us is a CUDA gate; not asserted on CPU

gates.name: viscoelastic energy monotonicity
gates.fail_if: with thermal noise OFF, Hopfield Lyapunov energy does not strictly dissipate
gates.negative_control: zero the memory kernel (Markovian) -> monotone_frac MUST drop below 0.99

gates.name: decoder information retention
gates.negative_control: naive linear down-projection -> mi_ratio MUST fall below 0.95

gates.name: relational operator headroom
gates.fail_if: training-free centroid snap fails to beat the linear least-squares baseline on held-out operators
gates.negative_control: linear least-squares baseline on the same split -> MUST score below the resonator

gates.name: sagnac fail-closed veto
gates.fail_if: phase-inverted (d_phi=pi) candidates are not deflected at the dark port (Delta > 0.35)

gates.name: proprietary purity
gates.fail_if: any module in henri_core imports transformers, huggingface_hub, or loads a third-party checkpoint

gates.name: decoder parameter envelope
gates.fail_if: full-config decoder falls outside the 400M-500M sub-billion envelope
gates.negative_control: tiny config -> MUST fall below 400M (proves the counter reads real params)
